case_01_order_processor.py.description: Order processing module with 4 planted issues plus one discovered discount-logic bug

expected_findings.description: add_to_cart uses cart=[] as a default, shared across calls
get_unique_skus uses list membership check -- O(n^2)
submit_order catches a bare Exception, hiding real failures
calculate_total accumulates float rounding error for money math
find_user uses = instead of == in the if condition
get_average divides by len(scores) without checking for an empty list

case_03_clean_validator.py.description: Originally intended as a clean baseline; two real issues were discovered by the agent during eval and confirmed genuine. No longer used as the false-positive probe -- see case_05 for that role.

expected_findings.description: validate_password raises TypeError on None or non-string input -- no type guard before len()/any() calls
EMAIL_PATTERN only allows one dot in the domain, incorrectly rejecting valid subdomains like user@mail.example.com

case_04_pagination_offby1.py.description: Off-by-one bug in pagination, plus a related floor-division undercount in total_pages

expected_findings.description: paginate treats page as 0-indexed in the caller's likely 1-indexed usage -- page=1 skips the first page_size items
total_pages uses floor division, undercounting when item_count isn't an exact multiple of page_size

case_05_clean_math.py.description: New, more carefully verified clean baseline -- defensively written with explicit guards for the exact edge cases (empty input, division by zero) that tripped up case_03. Use this as the false-positive probe going forward.
